{"title":"Courier Delivery Commitments by Destination","html":"
DestinationDelivery
WindowConditions
Metro Manila2–3 daysOrders confirmed before 14:00 on a business day are dispatched the same day; deliveries to gated communities may require recipient confirmation at the lobby, which can add up to one business day.
Greater Luzon3–4 daysService covers municipalities with a permanent courier route; barangays classified as remote by the operator are served twice weekly, and road closures caused by typhoons may suspend delivery without prior notice.
Visayas3–5 daysShipments travel by roll-on/roll-off vessel or air freight depending on volume, and inter-island transfers can be delayed by port congestion or adverse weather; tracking updates are issued at each handover point.
Mindanao4–6 daysCoverage includes major cities and selected municipal hubs, while addresses outside confirmed service areas are held at the nearest branch for customer pickup; delivery attempts are made on business days only.
Remote island areas5–7 daysDeliveries depend on scheduled boat trips and local transport availability, and the courier may contact the recipient to arrange a meeting point; additional storage charges apply after five calendar days at the destination branch.
